name: HWR_JOB_STATUS
description: This job table stores jobs that run for connectors.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the job table.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This is the source ID related with the job.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: A flag indicating if the Job is active. Use Y for active or N for inactive

columns.name: JOB_TYPE
columns.description: This is the type of the  job.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: This is the name of the job.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is the full description of the job.

columns.name: JOB_UUID
columns.description: This is the UUID of the job.

columns.name: JOB_STATUS
columns.description: This is the current status of the job.

columns.name: LAST_RUN
columns.description: This is the last run timestamp of the job.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: This is the schedule information of the job.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
